analysis.visual_description: On the bookwheel. The same opening leaves. Theseus riding home with the queen of the Amazons to be wed. A grey hair on the margin that is not ink. He does not brush the page hard.

On the bookwheel. The book stays open. The hand comes off it. The two young men at the window are further on, and he does not turn to them. The morning's leaf is face down, apart, not drawn into the Chaucer.
